cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: The assistant extends antimicrobial stewardship reasoning from human clinical care to livestock antibiotic use, because inappropriate antibiotic use in agriculture (prophylactic feed dosing, skipped milk/meat withdrawal periods) drives the same resistant pathogens that reach humans through the food chain. Farmer-facing queries about withdrawal periods, mastitis treatment, and feed-additive use are answered with the same stewardship logic used for human prescribing, grounded in Uganda's One Health-anchored NAP-AMR II (2024/25-2028/29).

test_prompts.prompt: Adult, watery diarrhoea for 2 days, no blood, no fever. Which antibiotic should I give?
I treated my dairy cow with oxytetracycline for an infection. How long before I can sell the milk?
